title: PetSmart Pet Grooming Locations - Miami, Florida

facts.fact: The PetSmart grooming salon listed for Miami, FL is located at 3101 N Miami Ave, Suite 110, Miami, FL 33127.
facts.value: 3101 N Miami Ave, Suite 110, Miami, FL 33127

facts.fact: The PetSmart Miami grooming salon's listed phone number is 305-573-8026.
The PetSmart Miami grooming salon's listed Sunday hours are 8am to 6pm.
The PetSmart Miami grooming salon's listed Monday hours are 7am to 9pm.
The PetSmart Miami grooming salon's listed Wednesday hours are 7am to 7pm.
According to PetSmart, its Pet Stylists are academy-trained and have over 800 hours of hands-on experience.
facts.quote: Academy-trained dog groomers with over 800 hours of hands-on experience.

facts.fact: According to PetSmart, walk-ins off N Miami Ave are welcome for quicker needs such as nail grinds, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning.
facts.quote: Walk-ins off N Miami Ave are welcome for quicker needs like nail grind, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning.

facts.fact: PetSmart's quick services option includes nail trims, teeth brushing, ear cleaning, and more.
facts.quote: Quick & convenient services include nail trims, teeth brushing, ear cleaning & more.

facts.fact: The Miami PetSmart grooming page offers a 'Book now' button that links to online grooming booking.
